sources.entry: PodFetch - Sleek and efficient podcast downloader. (Source Code) Apache-2.0 Docker/Rust

summary.one_liner: PodFetch is a self-hosted podcast manager and web app that downloads podcasts and lets you listen to them online, with GPodder sync support.
summary.what_it_does: PodFetch is a web application for downloading and playing podcasts, written in Rust with a React frontend. It includes a GPodder integration so existing podcast apps can keep syncing with it. It supports Podcasting 2.0 transcripts with full-text search across episode speech. It can generate missing transcripts through any OpenAI-compatible Whisper API. The README says a new Docker image is built and pushed to Docker Hub on every commit to the main branch, and suggests using a tool like Watchtower to keep the container updated. Documentation and a UI preview are linked from the README.
use_cases: listen to podcasts in a browser
how_to_run: Run the Docker image published to Docker Hub (the README says images are built from the main branch)
notable: GPodder integration so existing podcast apps keep working
Podcasting 2.0 transcript support with full-text search
Transcript generation via any OpenAI-compatible Whisper API
Docker image rebuilt on every commit to main
caveats: README gives no detailed install steps; points to external documentation
Docker image tracks the main branch, so updates are untested builds
